title: land runs an item's checks with the branch's own code, so a change to run_check proves itself
goal: Answers the SP-vmxdxtru retrospective: ST-d35ns45r's check calls bl_base.run_check, and land's checks step ran it from the landing process, which had imported the old run_check before the rebase, so the outer run named no KB_TEST_RUN_HOME and the check failed at step checks until the orchestrator preset the variable. land's checks and done steps run an item's checks through a fresh process of the rebased branch's backlog.py, so the code under test is the branch's at every level; backlog.md and tools.md say so.
